description: Starts a listing from a ready staged model with the title, description, tags and price you suggest. Pass the shop, material and colors from get_listing_options when the user chose them, and the listing page starts on them. The user opens complete_url to confirm they own the rights, pick the shop and colors, add photos and publish. Nothing goes live until they do. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

colors.description: The colors the user chose, each as hex and finish from get_listing_options

material.description: The material the user chose, for example PLA

shop_id.description: The print shop the user chose, as shop.id from get_listing_options

name: create_listing_draft
title: Start a listing
